notes: C = metronóm aj pri hraní z klávesnice (sila úderu V/B). Stopy so zapnutým reproduktorom hrajú aj s bicími. × v riadkoch bubeníka vymaže riadok. AQ a mriežka v spodnom paneli.
notes_en: C = metronome also while playing from the computer keyboard (velocity V/B). Tracks with the speaker on also play along with drums. × in drum rows clears the row. AQ and grid in the bottom bar.
